gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests {@link UtcInstant#withNanoOfDay(long)}.

{@code withNanoOfDay} returns a copy of the instant with the nano-of-day replaced, keeping the same Modified J
ADDED i2: Modified Julian Days around the 1972-12-31 leap second (an extra second at 23:59:60).

ADDED i6: Cases for {@link #test_withNanoOfDay}.

Each row is {@code [startMjd, startNanoOfDay, newNanoOfDay, expectedMjd, expectedNanoOfDay]}. A {@code null} expected
ADDED i7: Simple in-range replacements keep the MJD and adopt the new nano-of-day.
ADDED i8: negative nano-of-day is invalid
ADDED i9: The largest value allowed on a normal day: NANOS_PER_DAY - 1.
ADDED i10: NANOS_PER_DAY (the leap-second slot) is only valid on the leap day.
ADDED i11: The largest value allowed on a leap day: NANOS_PER_LEAP_DAY - 1; invalid on normal days.
ADDED i12: NANOS_PER_LEAP_DAY is past the end of every day, so it is always invalid.
